final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT t.observstation, o.lunarstage, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusage, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM telescopes AS t JOIN observatories AS o ON o.observstation = t.observstation GROUP BY t.observstation, o.lunarstage), step2 AS (SELECT lunarstage, AVG(avg_bandusage) AS avg_of_station_averages, SUM(record_count) AS total_records FROM step1 GROUP BY lunarstage), step3 AS (SELECT SUM(avg_of_station_averages) AS sum_of_phase_averages FROM step2) SELECT step2.lunarstage, step2.avg_of_station_averages, step2.total_records, step2.total_records / step3.sum_of_phase_averages FROM step2 CROSS JOIN step3
